conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Deepak Kumar. Mera locker ka renewal kaise karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Deepak ji, main aapko guide karta hoon. Kya aap apna locker number ya account number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Account number hai 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 0 1 2 3. Locker number yaad nahi.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Koi baat nahi, maine check kar liya. Aapka locker renewal pending hai. Branch visit karke ya online payment se renew kar sakte hain.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Main aapko online renewal ke steps mail karta hoon. Payment ke baad locker renew ho jayega. Aur koi madad?
